scope: Separate real PCB image feasibility study on VisA PCB2, preregistered after the consumed PCB1 v1 pilot. Not wafer/SEM/factory accuracy and not tabular policy evidence.

predecessor.test_status: consumed; never rerun or tuned on
predecessor.reported_outcome: baseline global AUROC .7881 AP .827; patch224 AUROC .8098 AP .804; frozen-threshold patch recall .33 FAR .06 vs global recall .42 FAR .04 (negative for patch at threshold)

normalization: per-method per-dimension mean/std over that method's memory-train descriptors only

image_common.aspect: full-image resize, aspect ratio distorted (not preserved)

backbone.layer2_to_grid: avg_pool 2x2 stride 2 onto the layer3 grid

baseline224.label: v1-inspired patch baseline: 224x224, 14x14, coreset 1024, max patch distance

primary448.label: composite: 448x448, 28x28, coreset 2048, mean of 3 largest patch distances

highres448max.label: descriptive only: r448 memory, max patch distance

primary_endpoint.metric: defect recall at each method's own frozen calibration threshold (score > threshold)
success_requires_all: paired image bootstrap 95% percentile CI lower bound of recall gain > 0

bootstrap.unit: test image, paired across methods, resampled with replacement within label stratum

primary_endpoint.attribution: primary448 differs from baseline224 in resolution, grid, coreset size and score aggregation at once; a gain cannot be attributed to resolution alone
